messages.content: Hi Team, Now our partnership team allow us to switch this supply back to you and customer wish to be with you. Hence we have initiated the ET so please response. Thanks
Hi, you've now initiated an ET. Can you please provide a narrative? We are unable to understand what has occurred.
Hi Team, As per details received our partner OVO hold valid contract so we are unable to agree ET. please ask to customer to contact OVO. Thanks.

Hi team, once again please refer to the photo provided. This is unambiguously our customer. Please ask your customer for a photo of the meter to confirm the MSN, as it is likely that they switched in the wrong MPAN. Burns test if MSN is correct.
Hi, To resolve this issue faster, Please ask your customer to contact OVO. So our partnership team will verify the account. Thanks
Hi team, please update us at the earliest on what your partnership team says accordingly we shall send another ET request.
Hi, We hold the valid supply. We are not going to accept your ET until our partnership team allow us accept this. Thanks
Hi team, please refer to the photo provided, showing correct MSN on the meter. Please re-register customer ASAP as customer does not wish to switch over to you

Hi Team,
Response sent, we hold valid contract.
Thanks
Please re-register this customer ASAP. MSN shown in photos is 190014117, correctly associated with this MPAN and this address.
